title: Packing request
description: An order to be packed: the box types available, the items to ship, and the rules that constrain how they may be combined. All lengths are integer millimetres, all weights integer grams.

requestId.description: Caller's identifier for this order. Echoed back unchanged so logs on both sides can be correlated.

mode.description: standard packs by real geometry. fluid ignores geometry and packs by total volume, for liquids and squishable apparel. own_packaging skips boxing for items that ship in their own carton. Only standard is implemented.

boxes.description: Box TYPES the warehouse stocks, not physical boxes. The solver may use a type many times.

items.description: Order lines. One entry may represent several identical units via quantity.

dimensions.description: Integer millimetres. width is x, height is y (up), depth is z.

id.description: Unique among boxes in this request.

name.description: Human label, for the visualiser and for pickers. Not used by the solver.

interior.description: Usable space INSIDE the box, wall thickness already excluded.

maxWeight.description: Gross limit in grams, including tareWeight. Omit for no limit. Modelled but not enforced: the client is not hitting this yet.

tareWeight.description: Weight of the empty box in grams. Counts toward maxWeight.

available.description: How many of this type are on hand. null means effectively unlimited, which is the normal case.

id.description: Unique among items in this request. Identifies the LINE; individual units are addressed by id plus unit index in the response.

reference.description: The warehouse's own SKU or product code. Passed through untouched for display and scanning.

weight.description: Grams, per unit, not per line.

quantity.description: How many identical units this line represents.

groups.description: Free-text tags this item belongs to, for example DG-3 or keyboards. Rules are expressed over these, never over item ids.

rules.description: Constraints on how items may be combined. Absent means no constraints.

incompatibleGroups.description: Each entry is a set of groups where no two members may share a box. The legal driver is dangerous goods classes, but the mechanism is deliberately generic.

keepTogether.description: Each entry is a group whose members should share a box where possible. A preference, not a hard constraint: the solver will break it rather than fail the order.
